item.title: HOZO NeoSander
item.description: HOZO NeoSander, a palm-sized detail sander. Kickstarter opened January 20, 2026; the June 11, 2026 retail note says more than $2 million from over 14,000 backers. Amazon listing sold by HOZO. Identified on October 31, 2026 (2026-10-31). Stage at identification: Early–mid.

item.title: InvisOutlet Aura
item.description: Intecular InvisOutlet Aura, an in-wall outlet with a color night light. Kickstarter funded in 22 minutes on August 19, 2025. Brand shop still out of stock on October 31, 2026; Amazon listing sold by Intecular was in stock. Identified on October 31, 2026 (2026-10-31). Stage at identification: Early–mid.

item.title: Made In carbon steel griddle
item.description: Made In carbon steel griddle set on Amazon. Replaces Sabre Paris Bistrot flatware, which had no single Amazon product page. Identified on October 28, 2026 (2026-10-28). Stage at identification: Early.
